aboutUs.title: About Us
aboutUs.name: Pascal Jaquiéry
aboutUs.qualification: Project Manager, Certified Electrician | 16 years experience | Specialties: Heating Systems, Kitchens, Flooring, Bathrooms, Smart Home
aboutUs.hello: Hello! I'm Pascal Jaquiéry, a certified electrician and project manager with 16 years of hands-on experience in residential renovations. I specialize in transforming small apartments and homes with a focus on intelligent, cost-effective solutions. My expertise spans heating systems, kitchens, flooring, bathrooms, and Smart Home integration—all delivered end-to-end, from concept to completion.
aboutUs.techJourney: My journey began with hands-on electrical work and evolved into comprehensive project management. Over 16 years, I've guided many diverse clients from around the world through complete home renovations, learning that success lies in understanding both technical excellence and the customer's vision. This experience revealed a gap: expatriates and homeowners in Basel struggle with local standards, suppliers, and project coordination. I founded Basel Home Fixer to bridge this gap—combining practical execution with expert consulting.
aboutUs.keySkills: ✓ Certified Electrician | ✓ Project Management (End-to-End) | ✓ Heating Systems Design & Installation | ✓ Kitchen & Bathroom Renovation | ✓ Flooring Specialists | ✓ Smart Home Integration | ✓ Cost & Timeline Control | ✓ Client-Centric Consulting | ✓ German & English (seamless communication)
aboutUs.continuousLearning: The construction and home improvement industry evolves constantly—new technologies, materials, and smart home solutions emerge regularly. I stay current through industry certifications, supplier partnerships, and hands-on projects. My focus: mastering the latest heating technologies, Smart Home automation, and sustainable building practices to deliver cutting-edge solutions to my clients.
aboutUs.careerGoals: My vision is to establish Basel Home Fixer as the trusted advisor for expats and homeowners seeking transparent, expert guidance on home renovations. I aim to build a network of reliable, vetted specialists and expand into sustainable home solutions. Ultimately, I want every client to feel confident, supported, and delighted with their home transformation—not just fixed, but elevated.

projects.title: Projects
projects.introduction: Beyond Standard Solutions – Three Real Projects Delivered. What sets Basel Home Fixer apart is not just execution—it's intelligent solutions. We don't apply standard approaches; we identify what your specific situation needs and deliver accordingly. This often saves money, prevents future problems, and delivers results that exceed expectations.

project1.title: Kitchen Modernization – Gas to Electric Conversion
project1.challenge: Renovating an older residential kitchen while converting infrastructure from gas to electric—a complex undertaking with multiple systems to integrate.
project1.solution: Complete infrastructure upgrade: Gas to electric conversion | New water and energy systems (right-sized for actual needs) | Modern lighting design with smart integration potential | Custom kitchen layout in partnership with Wohnpark Binzen | Strategic price negotiations that optimized value without compromising quality
project1.result: CHF 37,000 total investment | Customer gained a fully modern, energy-efficient kitchen with layout that perfectly fits their lifestyle
project1.valueDelivered: A generic contractor would have installed a standard kitchen. Our expertise ensured the right systems, layout, and cost optimization.

project2.title: Balcony Glazing – Seamless Project Execution
project2.challenge: Transform an open balcony into an enclosed, weather-protected space through complete planning, measurement, production coordination, and installation.
project2.solution: Detailed planning and precise measurements | Production coordination with reliable partners | Professional installation ensuring structural integrity and weatherproofing
project2.result: CHF 12,000 investment | Expanded usable living space with professional results
project2.valueDelivered: End-to-end management removes stress from the customer. We handle every phase so you enjoy the result.

project3.title: Heating System Modernization – Multi-Building Technical Excellence
project3.challenge: Upgrade heating infrastructure across 2 apartment buildings (18 units total) and replace all individual distributor units—a complex, coordinated project requiring technical expertise and attention to detail.
project3.solution: Modern heating system design and installation (Rosenmund) | Heat meter integration for cost control (Rapp) | Complete replacement of 18 individual distributor units | Coordination across two buildings with minimal disruption to residents
project3.result: CHF 60,000 investment | Energy-efficient heating, tenant cost transparency, future-proof infrastructure
project3.valueDelivered: A standard handyman would miss critical details. Our expertise detected issues that would have caused problems later, saving the owner significant future costs and tenant complaints.
